name: Easy Anti-Cheat
what_it_is: Anti-cheat service for online games, part of Epic Online Services.
platforms: Windows, Mac, Linux and Steam Deck; compatible with crossplay on console
pricing: Free tier plus paid Core, Fortified and Premier tiers via contact form; no prices shown.

facts.fact: Easy Anti-Cheat is part of Epic Online Services, according to the vendor site.
Easy Anti-Cheat's vendor site states that 200+ games and 35M+ players every month are protected.
The vendor home page lists support for Windows, Mac, Linux and Steam Deck and says it is compatible with crossplay on console.
The home page says basic protection is free with no credit card and no usage limits, and that integration is self-service through the Epic Online Services SDK.
Easy Anti-Cheat's licensing page lists free service tiers and paid Core, Fortified and Premier tiers, with no prices shown and a contact form for business inquiries.
